questions.question: What is Computer Vision?
questions.ideal_answer: Computer Vision enables machines to understand images and videos.

questions.question: What is Image Processing?
questions.ideal_answer: Image processing manipulates images to improve quality or extract information.

questions.question: What is OpenCV?
questions.ideal_answer: OpenCV is an open-source library for computer vision applications.

questions.question: What is Object Detection?
questions.ideal_answer: Object detection identifies and locates objects within images.

questions.question: What is Image Classification?
questions.ideal_answer: Image classification assigns labels to images.

questions.question: Explain CNN.
questions.ideal_answer: CNNs automatically learn image features using convolution layers.

questions.question: What is Image Segmentation?
questions.ideal_answer: Segmentation divides images into meaningful regions.

questions.question: YOLO vs RCNN?
questions.ideal_answer: YOLO is faster for real-time detection, RCNN is generally slower but accurate.

questions.question: What is Transfer Learning?
questions.ideal_answer: Reusing pretrained models for new vision tasks.

questions.question: Explain Bounding Boxes.
questions.ideal_answer: Bounding boxes are rectangles around detected objects.

questions.question: Build a Face Recognition System.
questions.ideal_answer: Use face detection, feature extraction and face matching models.

questions.question: Handle Low-Light Images?
questions.ideal_answer: Apply enhancement, denoising and preprocessing techniques.

questions.question: Real-Time Object Tracking?
questions.ideal_answer: Use YOLO with DeepSORT or ByteTrack.

questions.question: Optimize for Edge Devices.
questions.ideal_answer: Use quantization, pruning and lightweight models.

questions.question: Design Autonomous Vision Pipeline.
questions.ideal_answer: Capture images, preprocess, detect objects, track and make decisions.
